# Rough Notebook

> Your digital rough notebook for working things out. A free, browser-based scratchpad for quick notes, rough sketches, calculations, and visual problem-solving, with built-in arrays, matrix grids, and pointer annotations for coding and DSA problem-solving.

## Overview
- Product: Rough Notebook
- Tagline: Your digital rough notebook for working things out — the visual companion for solving coding problems.
- Live URL: https://shambhoo-narwaria.github.io/Rough-Notebook/
- Repository: https://github.com/shambhoo-narwaria/Rough-Notebook
- License: MIT Open Source
- Author: Shambhoo Narwaria
- Practice Companion For: LeetCode, NeetCode, HackerRank, Codeforces, CodeChef, and technical interview preparation.
- Core Purpose: Fast, distraction-free visual dry-running of algorithm logic, trace tables, two-pointer techniques, sliding windows, and recursion state.

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Smart Data Structure Blocks
- **1D Arrays:** Cell-based array blocks with auto-computed index labels (`[0]`, `[1]`, `[2]`), automatic resizing, and rapid keyboard navigation (`Tab` / `Shift+Tab`).
- **2D Matrices:** Grid-based blocks for dynamic programming tables, graph adjacency matrices, and 2D traversal.
- **Note Cards:** Markdown-capable sticky notes for algorithm invariants, edge cases, and state variables.
- **Dividers:** Full-width divider spines to segment problem stages (e.g., Initialization, Loop Invariant, Final Return).
- **Block Repositioning:** Every block includes a clean 4-directional move handle to drag and reposition widgets anywhere with collision resolution.

### 2. Smart Handwriting Mode (AI / Vector Stroke Engine)
- **Zero-Distraction Recognition:** Write naturally on the canvas using a stylus, pen, or mouse; handwriting automatically converts to clean text directly in the active note in the background without modal review screens.
- **Algorithmic Token Normalization:** Automatically recognizes and normalizes code tokens:
  - Big-O complexity: `O(1)`, `O(n)`, `O(log n)`, `O(n log n)`, `O(n^2)`, `O(V + E)`
  - Pointers and indexing: `arr[i]`, `nums[k]`, `node->next`, `root.left`, `root.right`
  - DSA keywords: `DFS`, `BFS`, `dp`, `MOD`, `target`
  - Operators: `<=`, `>=`, `===`, `!=`
- **Simultaneous Hybrid Input:** Type with keyboard while drawing or writing with stylus at the same time.
- **Fail-Safe Ink Preservation:** Low-confidence marks or offline sessions preserve raw handwriting ink without data loss.

### 3. Smart Testcase Paste & Auto-Create
- Copy raw test inputs directly from LeetCode, Codeforces, or HackerRank (e.g. `[2, 7, 11, 15]` or `[[1,2,3],[4,5,6]]`) and paste (`Cmd+V` / `Ctrl+V`).
- Rough Notebook automatically detects and instantiates interactive array or matrix widgets immediately.

### 4. Freehand Annotation Pen Layer
- Dedicated vector sketch layer for drawing pointer arrows (`L`, `R`, `slow`, `fast`), recursion tree branches, and graph edges.
- Multi-color radial palette: Ink (primary), Red (conflicts/base cases), Green (matches/solutions), Blue (pointers).
- Multi-level undo/redo per stroke.

### 5. Privacy and Architecture
- 100% Client-Side: Runs entirely in the user's browser with zero trackers, zero telemetry, and zero mandatory backend accounts.
- Built with Svelte 5, TypeScript, and Vite.

## Comparison: Why Rough Notebook vs Alternatives

| Feature | Rough Notebook | Excalidraw | Physical Paper | Miro |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Primary Focus | DSA & Algorithm Dry-Runs | General Diagrams | Manual Notes | Enterprise Collaboration |
| Indexed Array Widgets | Yes (Auto `[0]`, `[1]`, `[2]`) | No (Manual shapes) | Yes (Manual pen) | No |
| DP Matrix Grid with Tab | Yes | No | Yes (Manual grid) | No |
| Paste Raw LeetCode Arrays | Yes (Instant parsing) | No | No | No |
| Handwriting to Code Conversion | Yes (DSA Token Normalizer) | No | No | No |
| Keyboard Velocity | Yes (`Cmd+/`, `Tab`, `Cmd+C/V`) | Mouse-heavy | Manual | Mouse-heavy |
| Offline & Zero Setup | Yes (Static SPA) | Yes | Yes | Requires login |
